kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنفعل (form VII)
# أَنْفَعِلُ (ʔanfaʕilu) /ʔan.fa.ʕi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# أَنْفَعِلَ (ʔanfaʕila) /ʔan.fa.ʕi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# أَنْفَعِلْ (ʔanfaʕil) /ʔan.fa.ʕil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
